message: パイナップルバトラー
With less than a month left until the Holy Night Festival, Shiokumi Shopping District is already decked out for Christmas, so I wonder how the folks in Ryuusei Town are doing?
I head over to Tsukinoo Park and take in the sight of parents with children and couples relaxing by the wharf, along with longshoremen bustling busily about.
The sea breeze feels pleasant, yet chilly. It's already full-blown winter down by the shore, isn't it.

name: Young Girl
message: 「U-Um... You're putting me on the spot...」

name: Melphas
message: 「Oh, what a delightfully modest young lady you are. If I were to liken your grace to something, yes... it would be the fleeting delicacy of baby's breath」

name: Synn
message: 「M-Melphas is hitting on girls again」

name: Paqy
message: 「What a pompous jerk. No girl's gonna fall for cheesy pickup lines like those.」

name: Melphas
message: 「...Ahem!」
After shooting a quick glance and a nod toward Paqy and me, Melphas goes right back to spouting flowery platitudes.

name: Melphas
message: 「Alas, how I wish to protect that pure, lovely blossom. Yet I fear that merely touching you would cause you to snap. What an unattainable love this is」

name: Young Girl
message: 「I-I'm sorry... Even if you say things like that to me, I don't really know how to respond...」

name: Young Girl
message: 「Is this gentleman an acquaintance of yours, Lolotte?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, I am feeling quite hungry.」

name: Young Girl
message: 「H-Hey, Lolotte. He went out of his way to speak to us, so acting like that is rude...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Huh? Well, I don't understand a single word he's saying, do I? So it's the exact same as if he weren't talking at all.」

name: Melphas
message: 「Heh, I stand corrected. Lady Lolotte truly sees straight to the essence of things.」

name: Melphas
message: 「My entire being is reflected within those crimson rose-like eyes of yours... Oh, this love-struck body of mine feels as though it might burn to ashes」

name: Synn
message: 「Melphas? Lolotte's eyes are a clear blue, you know?」

name: Melphas
message: 「Lady Lolotte. My entire being is reflected within those blue rose-like eyes of yours... Oh, this love-struck body of mine...」

name: Melphas
message: 「No, no, fiery imagery really isn't fitting for a water-toned hue, is it. What a predicament.」

name: Paqy
message: 「What a lazy hack. At least prep your metaphor material beforehand!」

name: Melphas
message: 「Prep, you say... Oh, now that you mention it, I happen to have a sweet red bean bun and Milky Milk in my pocket. How does that sound, Lady Lolotte?」

name: Synn
message: 「Keeping milk stocked at all times--you're a good person, Melphas!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Is that really your standard for judging people?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Anpan... drooool♪」

name: Young Girl
message: 「R-Lolotte, you're drooling, you're drooling...!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「M-Mmhmm~~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh, come to think of it. Grandpa told me I mustn't accept food from people I'm not close with」

name: Melphas
message: 「Then let us become intimately acquainted, starting tonight」

name: Riesling
message: 「Please leave the defense of the two young ladies' chastity to me, their butler, Riesling Tooyama」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Grandpa's entrances are always so cool. *Sigh*」

name: Melphas
message: 「Oh, so this is the one...」

name: Riesling
message: 「Red alert. Target acquired, trigger open」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You don't have to point a gun at him out of nowhere--」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, he's already shooting without even asking questions!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Now that's some impressive marksmanship. Every single shot hit that pompous bastard right in his vital spots」

name: Riesling
message: 「You flatter me」

name: Melphas
message: 「Young lady like baby's breath, if you would be so kind, might I ask your name?」

name: Young Girl
message: 「E-Eeeek! S-S-S-Save me~~~!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, if a guy takes a ton of live rounds and comes at you completely fine, anyone'd freak out」

name: Melphas
message: 「Heh, a scream truly akin to tearing pure, unblemished white silk... It almost stirs a base lust within me」

name: Synn
message: 「Melphas, aren't your descriptions starting to lean in a really bad direction?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Just how many cartridges is that butler carrying on him?」

name: Melphas
message: 「Magnificent. Between each tracer round, there are four invisible bullets mixed in, aren't there?」

name: Melphas
message: 「Standard rounds, armor-piercing, high-explosive, and incendiary, by my reckoning. How close am I?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Next time, I shall mix in some hollow-points as well.」

name: Melphas
message: 「A sound judgment, however...」

name: Melphas
message: 「Even if they are just peashooters, they do sting quite a bit, so would you kindly stop soon?」

name: Riesling
message: 「For dessert, we have a pomegranate.」
Riesling pulls something resembling a large mallet from her bosom and tosses it to Melphas.

name: Melphas
message: 「Catch.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Farewell.」

name: Synn
message: 「She took Lolotte and her friend and left, huh.」

name: Melphas
message: 「Here, take this pomegranate... no, pineapple. Considering the safety of the surrounding citizens, this is something you, as the Student Council President, ought to hold onto.」
Melphas hands the strangely large mallet over to me.

name: Synn
message: 「What is this thing? It looks like a hand grenade from a war movie.」

name: Melphas
message: 「It is the real thing.」

name: Synn
message: 「W-White smoke is coming out of it, though!?」

name: Melphas
message: 「While there is life, there is hope... Until we meet again.」

name: Paqy
message: 「S-See ya!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, even you're ditching me, Paqy--」

name: Synn
message: 「Aaaaaaahhhhhhh~~~~...!!」
